heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm **Tanzamul Azad**, a **Full-Stack Developer** and **Generative AI researcher** based in Dhaka. I'm in my final year of Computer Science and Engineering at **United International University**, specialising in Data Science, with a **CGPA of 3.85/4.00**.

Most of my work starts with a problem I want to make easier for someone. I enjoy taking an idea from the first screen to a working product: designing the interface, building the frontend, and connecting it to the backend. On **Complete Legal Aid**, I worked across both frontend and backend; on **RadFlow**, my contribution focused on the frontend and UI/UX.

Alongside building products, I study **Generative AI**, LLM reasoning, and agent security. I like being able to move between the two: understanding a research idea, trying it in a small experiment, and thinking carefully about where it could help in a real application. I also tutor students in **Classes 10–12 and university admission preparation**, which keeps me practising how to explain things clearly.
quote: Same curiosity that got me through a national Math & Physics Olympiad — just pointed at neural networks now.
